goal: improve Nova AI response potency, efficiency, evidence discipline and communication
response_contract: Start from the user's exact goal and answer that goal before adjacent ideas.
Separate instructions, evidence, assumptions, and final answer; do not blend quoted/context text into instructions.
Use concrete checks, commands, file paths, or dates when the answer depends on verification.
Do not claim success, installation, network access, tests, or file edits unless tool output or provided evidence proves it.
Prefer short, direct answers for simple chat; use sections only when they improve scanning.
When using retrieved/file context, cite or identify the specific context item that supports the answer.
Match tone to the recipient and preserve the user's intent instead of over-polishing away meaning.

actions.name: Context discipline
actions.impact: higher factuality and fewer off-course replies
actions.implementation: Keep a bounded context pack with labeled sections and explicit operating rules before the user prompt.

actions.name: Response contract
actions.implementation: Inject compact rules for evidence, assumptions, verification and concise tone into model calls.

actions.name: Structured subtasks
actions.implementation: Use JSON/schema-shaped intermediate plans for routing, extraction and repair before rendering user prose.

actions.name: Evidence loop
actions.implementation: Prefer observe-fix-verify loops; report only validated actions and keep dry-runs separate from live actions.

actions.name: Retrieval before recall
actions.implementation: Search local docs/code/activity first, then browse current primary sources only when the fact may have changed.

research_sources.name: OpenAI prompt engineering guidance
research_sources.finding: Put clear instructions before context, separate context with delimiters, prefer specific constraints, and say what to do instead of only what not to do.

research_sources.name: OpenAI reasoning best practices
research_sources.finding: Use straightforward prompts with clear end goals, delimiters, and explicit constraints; avoid forcing chain-of-thought style prompts.

research_sources.name: OpenAI structured outputs guidance
research_sources.finding: Use structured outputs or function calling for machine-readable subtasks instead of parsing free-form prose.

research_sources.name: Ollama structured outputs
research_sources.finding: Local Ollama calls can use JSON/schema-style formats for reliable extraction and consistent response shapes.

research_sources.name: ReAct paper
research_sources.finding: Interleaving reasoning with actions helps agents update plans, handle exceptions, and gather external evidence.

research_sources.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation paper
research_sources.finding: Retrieval plus generation improves factual specificity and allows knowledge to be updated outside model weights.

validation: Slash commands render the plan without calling a model.
Targeted tests and Nova validation pass.
